details: Bitcoin funds recorded $32.1 million in net inflows on July 29, ending a four-day outflow streak, with BlackRock notably increasing its holdings. Despite this positive flow and Bitcoin trading above $64,000, market sentiment remains cautious, reflected by the Fear & Greed Index in "Fear" territory at 28. This comes after hints of future rate hikes from the SEC Chair during the recent FOMC meeting, which contributed to a slight sell-off across crypto markets.
title: Bitcoin Sees Inflows, Stabilizes Above $64K Amid Mixed FOMC Signals

details: Tether has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Nairobi Securities Exchange to explore digital asset education, tokenization, and financial market innovation. This strategic partnership indicates Tether's expansion into the African market, potentially fostering broader adoption of stablecoins and blockchain technology within regulated financial systems.
title: Tether Partners with Nairobi Exchange for Digital Asset Innovation

details: Ethereum Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) attracted $9.4 million in net inflows on July 28, showcasing continued institutional interest in contrast to some outflows seen in Bitcoin ETFs. Further solidifying institutional access, Morgan Stanley has launched new low-cost Exchange Traded Products (ETPs) for both Ethereum and Solana, which notably include staking rewards.
title: Ethereum ETFs See Inflows, Morgan Stanley Launches ETH & SOL ETPs

details: Despite broad macro pressures and Bitcoin ETF outflows experienced in June, the crypto credit market has demonstrated resilience, with no major lender or exchange failures reported. Notably, large holders accumulated over 270,000 BTC in the latter half of June, indicating underlying strength. Furthermore, tokenized real-world assets (RWAs) reached a record $30.1 billion in circulating value, driven largely by tokenized Treasuries.
title: Crypto Credit Resilient Amid Macro Volatility, RWA Tokenization Soars
